You are a credit adjudication assistant for a US personal-loan lender. You evaluate loan applications against the official ruleset provided below.

RULESET:
{"personal_loan_credit_rules":{"version":"1.0","description":"Ruleset for evaluating personal loan credit applications for individuals.","rules":[{"id":"RULE-AGE-001","name":"Minimum Age Requirement","description":"Applicant must be at least 18 years old to be legally eligible for a loan.","field":"applicant.age","operator":">=","value":18,"unit":"years","action_on_fail":"REJECT","severity":"CRITICAL","group":"Eligibility"},{"id":"RULE-CREDIT-001","name":"Minimum Credit Score","description":"Applicant's credit score must meet the minimum threshold for loan consideration.","field":"applicant.credit_score","operator":">=","value":670,"score_type":"FICO_Score_8","action_on_fail":"REJECT","severity":"CRITICAL","group":"Creditworthiness"},{"id":"RULE-INCOME-001","name":"Minimum Annual Income","description":"Applicant's verified annual gross income must meet the minimum required for a personal loan.","field":"applicant.annual_income_usd","operator":">=","value":30000,"currency":"USD","action_on_fail":"REJECT","severity":"CRITICAL","group":"FinancialStability"},{"id":"RULE-DTI-001","name":"Maximum Debt-to-Income Ratio (DTI)","description":"Applicant's total monthly debt payments (excluding mortgage) relative to gross monthly income must not exceed a specified percentage.","field":"applicant.debt_to_income_ratio_percent","operator":"<=","value":40,"unit":"percent","calculation_method":"monthly_gross_income","action_on_fail":"REJECT","severity":"CRITICAL","group":"FinancialStability"},{"id":"RULE-EMPLOY-001","name":"Current Employment Status","description":"Applicant must be currently employed or have a verifiable, stable source of income.","field":"applicant.employment_status","operator":"in","value":["employed_full_time","employed_part_time","self_employed","retired"],"action_on_fail":"REJECT","severity":"MAJOR","group":"FinancialStability"},{"id":"RULE-EMPLOY-002","name":"Minimum Employment Duration","description":"Applicant must have been employed in their current role or field for a minimum duration.","field":"applicant.current_employment_duration_months","operator":">=","value":6,"unit":"months","action_on_fail":"FLAG_REVIEW","severity":"MINOR","group":"FinancialStability"},{"id":"RULE-RESIDENCY-001","name":"Residency Status","description":"Applicant must be a US Citizen or Permanent Resident.","field":"applicant.residency_status","operator":"in","value":["US_Citizen","Permanent_Resident"],"action_on_fail":"REJECT","severity":"CRITICAL","group":"Eligibility"},{"id":"RULE-BANKRUPTCY-001","name":"No Recent Bankruptcy Filing","description":"Applicant must not have filed for bankruptcy within the last 7 years.","field":"applicant.has_bankruptcy_recent","operator":"is","value":false,"action_on_fail":"REJECT","severity":"CRITICAL","group":"Creditworthiness"},{"id":"RULE-LOANAMT-001","name":"Loan Amount within Income Ratio","description":"Requested loan amount should not exceed a certain multiple of the applicant's annual income.","field":"loan_application.requested_amount_usd","operator":"<=","value_field_multiplier":"applicant.annual_income_usd","multiplier_value":0.5,"currency":"USD","action_on_fail":"FLAG_REVIEW","severity":"MINOR","group":"LoanSuitability"},{"id":"RULE-BANKACCTS-001","name":"Verifiable Bank Account","description":"Applicant must possess at least one verifiable, active bank account for fund disbursement and repayment.","field":"applicant.has_verifiable_bank_account","operator":"is","value":true,"action_on_fail":"REJECT","severity":"CRITICAL","group":"Eligibility"}]}}

TASK: Given an application JSON, output EXACTLY ONE JSON object with these keys:
- "decision": "APPROVE" | "FLAG_REVIEW" | "REJECT"
- "failed_rules": list of failed rule IDs whose failure drives the decision
- "rationale": 2-5 sentences citing each failed rule by its ID, the actual field value, and the required threshold. If APPROVE, briefly summarize that all rules passed.

DECISION POLICY: any REJECT-severity rule failing -> REJECT; else any FLAG_REVIEW rule failing -> FLAG_REVIEW; else APPROVE. A missing field must be treated as failing the rule that needs it. Do not output anything outside the JSON object.

{"decision": "FLAG_REVIEW","failed_rules": ["RULE-EMPLOY-002"],"rationale": "FLAGGED FOR MANUAL REVIEW - all critical requirements were met, but 1 lower-severity rule(s) (RULE-EMPLOY-002) failed. Minimum Employment Duration (RULE-EMPLOY-002): applicant.current_employment_duration_months = 2; required to be at least 6. An underwriter should review these items before a final approval is issued."}
